name: Vzaperti
source: An atmospheric visual novel depicted in the style of anime. A touching and gripping story about a young man, Maks, who went in search of the missing red headed girl of his dreams in an abandoned, mysterious detached house. Will he manage to save the beauty and unravel the mystery of the cursed mansion?
translation: 一部以动漫风格描绘的大气视觉小说。这是一个感人至深、扣人心弦的故事，讲述了一个名叫麦克斯的年轻人在一所废弃的神秘独立屋里寻找他梦中失踪的红发女孩的故事。他能成功拯救美女并解开被诅咒的宅邸之谜吗？
